description: Header file defining the WebKitBrowser class, which implements plugin, web, and JSON RPC interfaces for a web browser component within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes nested Notification and Data classes, and declares methods for plugin lifecycle, web interactions, and JSON RPC handling.

classes.name: WebKitBrowser
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing web browser functionalities, plugin lifecycle, and JSON RPC interfaces.

classes.name: WebKitBrowser::Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling notifications from remote connections, state control, and webkit browser events.

classes.name: WebKitBrowser::Data
classes.description: Nested class representing JSON data structure for browser state including URL, FPS, Suspended, and Hidden flags.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service object.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Handles the event when a page load finishes.

methods.name: LoadFailed
methods.description: Handles the event when a page load fails.

methods.name: endpoint_bridgereply
methods.description: Handles bridge reply JSON RPC call.

methods.name: endpoint_bridgeevent
methods.description: Handles bridge event JSON RPC call.

methods.name: get_localstorageenabled
methods.description: Checks if local storage is enabled.

methods.name: event_loadfinished
methods.description: Event handler for page load finished.

methods.name: event_loadfailed
methods.description: Event handler for page load failure.

methods.name: event_bridgequery
methods.description: Event handler for bridge query message.
